about: DarwinRootVault's own test vectors. Numbers are 32-byte big-endian words, addresses their 20 bytes. leaf = keccak256(0x00 || quoteHash || payee || amount); pair = keccak256(0x01 || left || right); each level pairs its nodes in order and carries an unpaired last node up unchanged; key = keccak256(0x02 || vault || root || leafCount). A path holds a leaf's siblings from the bottom up, one per level where it has one. hashes.json holds single hashes; each wave file holds a wave, its leaves, root and key (naming `vault`) and paths. In every file here, each integer (amounts, leaf counts, places, path indices and the leaf limit) is a 0x-prefixed hex string, never a JSON number, so that readers in any language parse values up to 2^256 - 1 alike.
